# Payment Preparation Functions

Payment-specific domain preparation and candidate validation. A template must be a Payment Instruction with declared payer, payee and guarantor roles. Frozen payment terms require positive integral `amountMinor`, nonnegative integral `limitMinor`, amount no greater than limit, nonempty currency and limit at most 1,000,000,000,000. Configured capture/transfer policy gates are recorded in those terms. Provision rejects any changed frozen payment terms.

For a ready selected instruction, `domainNextActions` validates an optional typed `paymentAction` and describes its responsible party, document, amount and currency. No action is described when it is absent. The description grants no authority and proves no payment completion.

Preparation freezes a requirement before creation or provision. Provision requires the expected supplier, request correlation, requirement reference and initialized document origin. Normalized source, effective policy, every party role and identity, allowed value slots and approval requirements must match. An extra undeclared party is rejected even when the child acquired it through its own admission; a stored witness cannot authorize an expanded roster. An unrelated old field alone is not a rejection rule.

Selection is distinct from usability. General admission can seek authorized approval, the incoming participant's consent and access before linking. A selected child becomes usable only when its Activation is active and its source and reader requirements are ready. Identity substitution is rejected; matching retries do not create a second obligation.
